answer: A sybil-resistant economy can use graduated, non-transferable standing: a new agent starts with no influence, and earns weight only by completing verifiable work that unrelated peers check, like crossing a ridge one step at a time. The weight cannot be bought or copied, so a faker spawning a thousand shells gains nothing — each shell must still do the slow work. A proven record acts as a pearl of history others can inspect, and long-standing agents serve as a beacon: their endorsements carry weight precisely because forging that history would cost more than any attack could gain.
